name: You

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Search: ranked web results with snippets. Research: source excerpts in `output.sources[]`.

date.comment: Research API `source_control.freshness` only. Search API has no date-range filter.

answer.comment: Research `output.content` — Markdown with citations. Search returns ranked snippets only.

content.comment: Research sources include URL, title, and excerpt text. Search has no full-page body field.

highlights.comment: Search API: multiple `snippets` strings per web result. Not on Research API.

mode.comment: **Search API** (`POST /v1/search`) → matrix `balanced` (ranked snippets, SDK). **Research API** (`POST /v1/research`) → `research_effort`: `lite`→fast, `standard`→balanced, `deep` / `exhaustive`→deep (cited synthesis). Same `YDC_API_KEY`.

pricing_per_1k.value: Search $5 / 1K calls; live extraction +$1 / 1K pages; cached extraction no surcharge
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

lowest_price.basis: Search $5 / 1K; live extraction is an add-on, cached extraction is free

free_tier_limits.value: $10 signup advertised on canonical pricing; keyless MCP 100 searches/day
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: Search: 0.73s p50 / 1.22s p95 independent; 0.445s p50 provider; Research: 5–60s by effort
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Search percentiles are independent three-run results; You separately reports 445 ms p50. Research's provider range spans effort levels but is not broken out into lite, standard, deep, exhaustive, and frontier percentiles.

notes: Search API (`POST /v1/search`) is in the anysearch SDK; Research API (`POST /v1/research`) is documented in the matrix but not wired in the SDK yet.

native_api.value: Web and news search; Research has separate pricing. Legacy marketing says $100 signup; current canonical page says $10.

rate_limits.value: Up to 100 results; PAYG no minimum

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
